headline: Australian Capital City House Prices Fall Across the Board
summary: House prices dropped across every Australian capital city for the first time in 15 years, with Sydney prices falling 4.7% to $1.66 million.
why: Residential real estate represents the majority of Australian household wealth and is highly sensitive to changes in mortgage rates.

impacts.name: Australian Real Estate
impacts.why: Broad price declines weigh on property transaction volumes and residential equity values.
